observations: Photo 0 and 1 show a Nikon DSLR body with 'Nikon D3300' printed clearly on the body front and on the retail box ('D3300 18-55 VR II Kit').
Photo 0/1 show an 18-55mm VR II kit lens with caps on, sitting beside the body on top of its original box.
Background shows other shop stock (flash units, selfie stick boxes labeled Godox, TT520, Yongnuo) — these are not part of this listing, just shop clutter.
No photo shows the camera powered on, LCD screen, lens mount contacts, shutter count, serial number, or any functional test.
No accessories (battery, charger, strap, memory card) are visible outside the box.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 and photo 1 both show 'D3300' printed on the camera body and on the retail box, not D3400.
Generic spec text, not readable from any photo; also attached to the wrong model name.
No video or burst-test clip provided; cannot be seen in static photos.
No viewfinder or AF test shot provided.

risks.risk: Seller misstated the model (D3400 claimed vs D3300 visible), raising doubt about the rest of the description's accuracy.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the camera's serial number/data plate under the lens mount or battery door matching a specific model.
risks.if_unproven: priced as the model actually shown in photos (D3300), not as claimed (D3400)

risks.risk: No proof the camera powers on, shutter fires, or sensor is clean (dust/fungus not visible in static shots).
risks.proof: A power-on photo/video showing live view, a test shot, and a shutter-count reading from camera menu.

risks.risk: Lens is shown with both caps on; optical condition (fungus, scratches, zoom/focus ring smoothness) cannot be judged.
risks.proof: Close-up photos/video of front and rear lens elements against light, and a zoom/focus action clip.
risks.if_unproven: priced as lens condition unknown/worst case

risks.risk: Completeness of kit (battery, charger, strap, memory card, manual) not shown outside the box.
risks.proof: A photo of all included accessories laid out next to the body and box.
risks.if_unproven: priced as body + lens only, no accessories

risks.risk: Shutter count/usage history unknown, which matters a lot for DSLR pricing.
risks.proof: Screenshot of shutter count from a shutter-count checking tool or camera info screen.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the serial/data plate to confirm true model (D3300 vs D3400).
Power-on photo or short video showing live view and a test shot.
Shutter count screenshot or in-camera info screen.
Close-up of lens elements (front/rear) and a focus/zoom action clip.
Photo of all accessories included (battery, charger, strap, card, manual).
response.reason: Photos clearly identify the item as a Nikon D3300 body with 18-55mm VR II kit lens in original box, contradicting the seller's D3400 claim; with no proof of function, lens condition, or completeness, it must be priced at worst case against comparable D3300/same-generation kits.
